_provenance: Taxonomy grounded in Lin, Xiu & Gorlatova 2026 (open-set detection prompt types: standard / underdetailed / overdetailed) and Li et al. 2025 RobustPrompt (within-group variation axes: article, synonym, sentence-length). Domain-neutral so the same bank applies indoor and outdoor.
overdetailed: a detailed high-resolution photo of a {name}
a photo of a single {name} with visible shape and texture
a close-up photo of a {name} showing fine details
a well-lit photo of a {name} with clear edges
